title: 3D Gaussian Splatting for Real-Time Radiance Field Rendering
layout_note: A short linear lead-in (SfM points -> Initialization -> 3D Gaussians) feeds a loop: 3D Gaussians -> Projection -> Differentiable Tile Rasterizer -> Image, with Adaptive Density Control below Projection closing the cycle back to the Gaussians. A Camera box enters Projection from above.
grouping: No containers or tints. The forward/backward split is made by arrow colour alone: black arrows for the operation flow, light-blue arrows running the other way beside them for the gradient flow, keyed in a boxed two-entry legend at the bottom right.
shapes_depth: Flat square-cornered rectangles: processing steps filled light grey with thin dark outlines, data endpoints (Camera, Image) left white. The two data ends are drawn as data, not boxes: the SfM input is a scatter of black dots and the central '3D Gaussians' node is a cluster of soft green blurred ellipses with a bold label under it. Arrows are curved black/blue pairs around the loop and straight between boxes.
proposed_highlight: The representation itself is the visual centre: the only coloured, non-box node is the blurred green ellipse cluster, labelled in bold, sitting where every loop arrow begins and ends. The rasterizer and density control are ordinary grey boxes.
lesson: Make the scene representation the hub of the optimisation loop and draw it as its own primitives (soft coloured ellipses), with paired black forward and light-blue gradient arrows so the differentiable path reads without words.
notes: venue from the PDF: 'ACM Trans. Graph. 42, 4' (SIGGRAPH 2023 journal paper; venue_source: pdf). Caption is cropped at the right edge in the crop but the drawing is complete. Measured with the crop's two zero-height images_px boxes dropped (they cover no pixels but make `kb measure` raise 'y1 must be greater than or equal to y0'); the result equals what a fixed measure would give.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)
